kcc_query_text_example: SC marginal dryland farmer with 2.0 acres rainfed ragi in Bagepalli, Chikkaballapura; acquired land title strictly via succession upon death of father (registered Death Certificate and Bhoomi mutation extract Form 12); applying for PMFBY crop insurance against drought and seeking PM-KISAN registration; inquiring whether succession upon death is exempt from post-Feb 2019 cut-off.

water_and_irrigation.grid_connection_evidence: No electric grid connection on plot

statutory_flags.succession_death_certificate: Registered Death Certificate Reg No. DC-2021-9872 issued by Bagepalli Revenue Authority (demise of registered landowner/father in August 2021)
statutory_flags.succession_legal_heir_order: Tahsildar Legal Heir Certificate LND/CR-089/2021-22 naming applicant as legal successor
statutory_flags.revenue_mutation_record: Bhoomi Mutation Register Extract MR-2021-0412 Form 12 and updated Record of Rights, Tenancy and Crops (RTC) Pahani under Section 128/129 of Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
statutory_flags.engine_cutoff_rule_input_interpretation: land_ownership_cutoff_pre_feb_2019 represents the frozen engine's consolidated cutoff-rule input (True = qualifies under pre-Feb 2019 ownership OR post-cutoff succession upon death of previous owner; False = ineligible post-cutoff transfer via partition deed, sale, or gift; None = unknown/unverified); the literal historical acquisition date is 2021-08-10 (post-01.02.2019), but qualifies for PM-KISAN under statutory succession exemption per PM-KISAN Revised Operational Guidelines §3(d) and Clarification §2.
statutory_flags.tenure_documentation: Succession upon death of registered landowner (father deceased in August 2021; Death Certificate Reg No. DC-2021-9872; Tahsildar Legal Heir Certificate LND/CR-089/2021-22; Bhoomi Mutation Register Extract MR-2021-0412 recording succession/inheritance; updated RTC Pahani). Transfer basis: INHERITANCE_DUE_TO_DEATH. Factual acquisition date: 2021-08-10 (post-01.02.2019). Statutorily exempt under PM-KISAN Revised Operational Guidelines §3(d) and Clarification §2; strictly distinguished from non-exempt post-cutoff transfers via family partition deed, sale deed, or gift deed. Input flag land_ownership_cutoff_pre_feb_2019=True represents the engine's consolidated cutoff-compliance rule.

attribute_provenance.empirical_baseline: Directorate of Economics and Statistics & Bhoomi Land Records: Dryland coarse cereal (finger millet / ragi) cultivators in northern taluks of Chikkaballapura (Bagepalli/Gudibande), high vulnerability to delayed monsoons.
attribute_provenance.farmer_query_inspiration: Bhoomi land records and KCC helpline: Farmers holding mutated land titles through family succession asking if PM-KISAN cut-off of 01.02.2019 bars them.
attribute_provenance.statutory_policy_test: Statutory Inheritance Exemption Test: Factual acquisition date is 2021-08-10 (post-01.02.2019); transfer basis is strictly INHERITANCE_DUE_TO_DEATH following demise of father with verified Death Certificate Reg No. DC-2021-9872, Tahsildar Legal Heir Certificate LND/CR-089/2021-22, and Bhoomi Mutation Register Extract MR-2021-0412 (Form 12); expressly exempt under PM-KISAN Revised Operational Guidelines §3(d) and Clarification §2, which strictly distinguishes succession following death from ineligible transfers via sale deeds, gift deeds, or inter-vivos family partition deeds; satisfies cutoff compliance input (land_ownership_cutoff_pre_feb_2019 = True); PM-KISAN qualifies in Section A (PMKISAN_CUTOFF_DATE_VERIFIED); PMFBY evaluates ELIGIBLE by raw engine for Ragi, but governance routes it to Section B as REQUIRES_VERIFICATION pending Kharif 2026 Gram Panchayat IU notification; Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Ganga Kalyana evaluated as ELIGIBLE by raw engine, but routed to Section B as REQUIRES_VERIFICATION without scoring under governance safeguard due to lack of recorded perennial water source adjacency.

intended_test_purpose: Validate PM-KISAN statutory succession exemption following death of landowner; route PMFBY crop insurance to Section B pending official Kharif 2026 GP-level notification check; apply established Ganga Kalyana source-adjacency governance safeguard.
unresolved_dependencies: Verification of GoK Kharif 2026 PMFBY Insurance Unit (Gram Panchayat level) notification and enrollment cut-off dates for rainfed Ragi in Bagepalli taluk, Chikkaballapura district
Field verification of land parcel adjacency to a qualifying perennial water source under Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Development Corporation individual irrigation guidelines
Chikkaballapura district administrative circular confirming rural family income ceiling for affirmative welfare corporation schemes
